messages:
deploy-bot: starting rc9 deploy to prod for service api-infer. Running pre-deploy gates: vuln-scan, sbom, license-check.

deploy-bot: PRE-DEPLOY RESULT: vuln-scan FAILED. transitive issue: CVE-2024-XXXX (low) via text-utils -> fasttext. License flagged: AGPL-like. SBOM provenance mismatch: image digest != recorded artifact. affected artifact commit `8f3e2b6`.

ajay: what's the exploitability? any public exploit?

maria: looks low severity, no public exploit. main risk is license + provenance. provenance mismatch might be CI metadata drift.

eric: can we pin the transitive dep to a fixed digest or vendor it quickly? if it's truly transitive we can dump a patched wheel into our build.

sophia: options: 1) block RC and rollback, 2) pin dep & canary, 3) request legal exception. i'd prefer pin + canary with aggressive monitoring.

security-review-bot: Automated policy alert: "supply-chain-provenance" triggered. Nonstandard license/provenance requires approval by @legal or @security.

maria: @legal please triage license risk. if we can get a temporary exception we can proceed in tonight's change window.

ajay: change window is 23:00 PST. delaying til morning impacts several customers. leaning canary at 23:00 with rollback ready.

eric: rollback command if needed:
```
rdeploy rollback --service api-infer --to-tag release/rc8
```

ajay: i'll update release notes with the canary + monitoring note.

maria: built a pinned image on branch `hotfix/pin-fasttext-2024` -> commit `8f3e2b6`. image: `gcr.io/redwood/api-infer:rc9-pin-8f3e2b6`.

deploy-bot: New image pushed. Canary scheduled for 23:00 PST. Canary plan: 5% traffic for 15m, evaluate latency p50/p95, error-rate, and model-quality evals, then 30m if green.

security-review-bot: Ticket created for legal exception: SEC-2024-513. Note: approval required within 24h for exception to stand.

sophia: i'll monitor canary metrics and evals-runner. set alerts for >2x error-rate or model-quality regression. immediate rollback on alert.

maria: proceeding with pinned image + canary. if legal denies we'll rollback and cut alternate patch.

ajay: draft release notes: "rc9 (hotfix): pinned transitive dependency to address license/provenance flag; canary rollout 23:00 PST; monitoring + rollback plan in place."

eric: :thumbsup: i'll be on call for rollout.

maria: filed SEC ticket and added notes.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary started (simulated) at 1719999888. Hooks: APM, evals-runner, cost-tracker.

sophia: 5m into canary: metrics look clean. latency and errors within baseline. promoting to 30m.

security-review-bot: Legal update: temporary exception APPROVED for 48h pending full provenance remediation. Ticket SEC-2024-513 updated.

ajay: rolling to full now. thanks team.

maria: i'll follow up with PR to fix SBOM provenance and close SEC ticket when resolved. Closing thread after ticket milestones.
